objective: Build the vanilla-ES-module SPA shell and the three dashboards (sign-in/register, customer requests and the request page with the six RS-35 answers, supplier orders and inventory, admin), plus the contract fixtures the UI is built against, the scan test and the unit tests.
context: Built against spec sections Frontend, Interface Contracts (customer, supplier, admin routes, shared response objects, labels), Security (output encoding, CSP) and the brief criteria RS-33, RS-34, RS-35, NFR2. c1/c2/c3 routes were not all live, so every route the UI calls has a contract fixture I own, copied from the spec shapes (checked against src/domain/planner.js, explain.js, derive.js and the migrations for enums and texts). No src/ file and no package.json change. FU-3 (SPEC_MISMATCH offers) is decided below.
inputs: src/domain/explain.js, src/domain/planner.js, src/domain/derive.js (read only, for texts, trace shape and enums)
expectedOutput: public/index.html, public/css/app.css, public/js/* (api, dom, format, router, store, poll, main, texts, errors, reserve-key, view-helpers), public/js/views/*, public/js/components/*; test/fixtures/contracts/*.json; test/scan/frontend.test.js; test/unit/frontend/format.test.js; test/unit/frontend/dashboards.test.js.
acceptanceCriteria: Hash routes #/signin, #/register, #/requests, #/requests/new (text only in this phase), #/requests/:id, #/supplier/orders, #/supplier/inventory, #/admin; one main#app, persistent #banner, aria-live #announcer

Request page sections 1-6 for the planning stages: status header with next step, 'What you need' with manual inputs for every core field, 'Why this plan' with trace comparisons, 'What was rejected' with blocking constraints, per-candidate codes and relaxation buttons, 'Total' from server cents with 'Test prices, not market prices', 'Supplier commitments' with Catalog offer and Supplier confirmed columns; Approve plan sends planHash and total; Reserve stores the Idempotency-Key in sessionStorage under reserve:<planVersionId>

api.js adds X-CSRF-Token, parses the envelope, aborts at 15 s; states loading, empty, error (message + requestId + Retry) and timeout render; text status indicators, never color alone; data-testid hooks as listed in the spec
DOM built with textContent and attribute setters only; test/scan/frontend.test.js asserts no innerHTML, no inline script or style attribute handlers, no secret-looking value in public/

test/fixtures/contracts/*.json hold example responses taken from the spec's contracts for every route the UI calls in this phase; format helpers tested in test/unit/frontend/format.test.js; dashboards.test.js checks the pure view-model functions of the request, supplier and admin views against the contract fixtures (section order, status text, relaxation buttons, Idempotency-Key reuse)
completedWork: Criterion 1: router.js parses and role-guards the eight hash routes; index.html has one main#app, #banner and aria-live polite #announcer, a skip link and landmarks; main.js moves focus to the h1 and announces the title on each route change (tests: 'RS-35: hash routes ...', 'NFR2: index.html ...', 'NFR2: each role reaches ...', main.js boot smoke test). Criterion 2: the request page is built from pure view models in components/* (status, fields-table, plan-card, rejections, totals, commitments, compensation, payments) in the order status, need, why, rejected, total, commitments, failure, actions; every field has a manual input (open by default when the extraction is degraded); trace comparisons are written from trace.comparisons ('A+B beats A+E: total $84.00 < $95.00'); rejections come from the planner's rejections array and show the server's template sentence for the code (fixed client template as fallback); infeasible runs show blocking constraints, per-candidate codes and one relaxation button per relaxation that re-confirms all values with the one constraint changed and re-plans; totals are formatted from server cents with the price notice; catalog offer and supplier-confirmed are separate columns; Approve plan sends planId, expectedTotalCents and planHash; Reserve takes its key from getReserveKey(sessionStorage, planId) stored under reserve:<planVersionId> and reuses it on retry/refresh (tests 'RS-16: ...'). Criterion 3: api.js is the only module that touches the network (one globalThis.fetch call site), adds X-CSRF-Token to non-GET calls, fetches the pre-login token when none is held, repeats once after CSRF_FAILED, parses the error envelope into ApiError, aborts at 15 s; notice.js renders loading, empty, error (message, action, request id, Retry) and timeout states; pills and badges always carry words. Criterion 4: dom.js builds nodes with createElement, createTextNode, textContent and setAttribute only and refuses on* attributes, style, srcdoc and non-http(s)/non-app URLs; the scan test asserts no markup parsing, no inline handlers or styles, no eval/Function/string timers, no external origin, no localStorage, no secret-shaped value, imports resolve, every button has a type, every control is built by the labelled form helpers. Criterion 5: 43 contract fixtures (list below), 95 frontend tests. Verification: baseline failed ev:ev-mv2p4dxf-01e156ae (test files absent); plan command passes 95/95; neighbours (http, health-config, all scan tests, frontend) 194/194. RS-34 labels: banner from config.labels (Simulated payments and/or AI, Test mode, single credential), Simulated and PayPal Sandbox badges on every payment element, Demo data badge on suppliers/offers/prices, price notice wherever prices show. FU-3 decision: SPEC_MISMATCH offers are NOT shown under 'What was rejected'; they are listed in the trace part of 'Why this plan' as 'Supplier F: Not a match for your cups (capacity or size)' (testid trace-skipped-<code>), rendered by template from trace.candidates[].skipped; test 'RS-35: FU-3 default ...'. SEC-7: only the server's template lines (explanation.lines, Question.question) are shown; Explanation.rephrased is never rendered. One guard refusal during the work: a command that cd'd and then wrote a relative path was refused; I redid the three edits with the Edit tool.
remainingIssues: FU-3 (for g1): decision recorded - SPEC_MISMATCH offers are shown in the trace list of 'Why this plan' (templated line 'Not a match for your cups (capacity or size)'), not under 'What was rejected'. g1 should verify this on the six-answer page; the planner has to keep writing skipped:'SPEC_MISMATCH' into trace.candidates for the line to appear.

Not run in a browser: this environment has no Playwright or Chromium. Everything is checked DOM-free (fake document) under node --test, including a boot smoke test of main.js. c6's browser suite should assert: no horizontal scroll at 360 px; visible 3 px focus; no CSP violation on load (module script, /favicon.svg, no inline style); focus on the h1 after each route change; the PayPal round trip (location.assign to the approval URL, then #/requests/:id?paypal=returned|cancelled&order=<id>); keyboard-only happy path; polling every 2 s while the status is transient and pause when hidden; the Retry and timeout states.

Fixture wrapper: each file is {route, status, variant?, headers?, request?, response}. c6's contract test should compare `response` by key set and field types, not by values. Success fixtures cover: GET /api/config (2 variants), GET /api/auth/csrf, GET /api/auth/session (customer, anonymous), POST /api/auth/signin|register|signout, GET|POST /api/requests, GET|DELETE /api/requests/:id (planned, reserved, infeasible, degraded views), POST extract|confirm|plan (feasible, infeasible), approve, reserve, paypal/create, execute (202 and 200 replay), abandon, receipt, GET /api/supplier/orders, supplier confirm|refuse|ready|handover, GET|PATCH /api/supplier/inventory, POST /api/admin/reset, POST /api/admin/faults, GET /api/admin/timeline, GET /api/admin/metrics; error envelopes: PLAN_CHANGED, RESERVATION_LIMIT, VALIDATION_FAILED, UNAUTHENTICATED, RESET_BLOCKED. Not covered because the UI does not call them in this phase: image upload/download, GET /api/health, PayPal return/cancel redirects, webhooks.

Contract gap (c2): the reserve button must explain 'You already hold stock for another request ... ' with a link to that request, but RESERVATION_LIMIT details carry only reservationIds, not a request id. The link therefore goes to #/requests. If c2 adds a request id to details, errors.js should link to it.

Contract gaps to confirm in c2/c3: (a) SupplierOrder.commitment is not typed in the spec; the fixture and UI assume the Order.commitment shape {bundles, readyAt, confirmedAt}. (b) GET /api/admin/timeline `cursor` is not typed; fixtures use integers and the UI passes the last cursor back unchanged as afterId. (c) Trace.candidates is object[]; the UI reads supplierCode and skipped only. (d) Request intakeStatus values draft|extracted|confirmed are taken from migration 002, not from the spec text.

The request page decides which action button to show from rescueStatus.nextStep.code (APPROVE_PLAN, RESERVE, APPROVE_PAYMENTS, RETRY_APPROVAL_OR_ABANDON, COMPLETE_PURCHASE, REPLAN, PLAN) together with plan and order state. c2's view service must keep those codes consistent with the plan state (for example APPROVE_PLAN only while the current plan is proposed); c6 should assert it.
Explanation.rephrased (opt-in AI rephrasing, off by default) is never rendered; if rephrasing is enabled later, a separately labelled 'AI-rephrased' block must be added and the SEC-7 test updated.
The scan test's secret patterns include a 40-character token regex; a future legitimate long literal in public/ would need an explicit allowance in the test rather than a weaker pattern.
nextAction: delivery-lead: send c5 to review (code and security: CSP, output encoding, the single API module). test-engineer (c6): build the contract test over test/fixtures/contracts/*.json against the live API once c1/c2/c3 are in, and the browser suite listed under remainingIssues. g1-frontend-a11y-labels: verify the FU-3 decision on the six-answer page.

lessonDecisions.note: appliesWhen concerns a hook or guard that maps writes to a project record in a repository with several records. This task builds browser assets and designs no hook or guard, and no write was denied for a wrong nested root; the one refusal was a command that did cd and then wrote a relative path, a different rule.
